mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% MoM signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over 3 consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs MoM signals strong labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, which together boost economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 0.5% and UNRATE MoM < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% YoY, combined with an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS), signals a recessionary environment with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY < -1% and FEDFUNDS > 4%.
